name: Trezarlo
backstory: Child of Farlo and Trezco; raised in Terfila on unloads crates at the market stalls through the..., and carries some knowledge of Death Of Niemius.

experience.text: Grew up hearing: Heard that Tamuken and Forliazco now have a child, Forliuken.
Grew up hearing: Heard that Forliamus and Farlo now have a child, Forliarlo.
Heard that Forliauzco and Farliazco now have a child, Farliauzco.
Heard that Tamuzco and Forliamuk now have a child, Tamuzaken.
Had a child with Forliukar, named Trezukar.
Heard that Forliauzco and Farliazco now have a child, Forliuzazco.
Heard that Tamuzco and Farliukar now have a child, Tamuzarlo.

criterion.standard: holds themself accountable to Birth Of Niergus, whatever it costs
criterion.wasted_life: one that never had to answer for Birth Of Niergus
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: takes to the transit route himself now when a ship idles too long in port, and finds he still slows near the temple without quite meaning to.

arc.premise: Trezarlo wants the rotted dock planking at the Terfila stalls actually replaced before another crate of goods goes into the harbor - he's found the timber, now he needs someone who can lay it properly.
